key.name: popup-keybinding
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens the Clipway clipboard history popup.

key.name: incognito
key.description: When true, new clipboard content is neither captured nor stored.

key.name: excluded-apps
key.description: Window class names whose clipboard content is never captured. Matching is case-insensitive.

key.name: history-depth
key.description: Maximum number of entries kept in history. Pinned entries are never evicted.

key.name: max-text-bytes
key.description: Clipboard text larger than this many bytes is not stored.

key.name: max-image-bytes
key.description: Clipboard images larger than this many bytes are not stored.

key.name: clear-on-logout
key.description: Remove unpinned history when the session ends. Pinned entries are kept.

key.name: sync-primary
key.description: Also record text copied with the middle mouse button into history.
